svg.title: Finite sequential original positive obstruction criterion
svg.desc: Original orders four through twenty-four correspond to sequential quotient gates s3 through s23. Each later gate is reached only when earlier gates vanish. First nonzero gives original positive rank37. Allzero gives rank36 by order31 exceeding degree30. Actual values are unknown.

g.text: A finite criterion, not an evaluated outcome
Original positive component: 37 × 41 · generic Laurent rank · actual gate values unknown
s3 → s4 → s5 → s6 → s7 → s8 → … → s23 · advance only if preceding classes vanish
33 unit pivots + three t² pivots + tⁿ⁺¹
A later pivot would force minor order ≥ 31
Sequential orders, not 21 independent parameters, probabilities or completion percentages.
PR1107 · No source selection or full-adjoint conclusion. Square-restriction recursion is not asserted.
